newsitem.title: IRAN: FOURTH ENGLISH DAILY LAUNCHED IN IRAN.
newsitem.headline: FOURTH ENGLISH DAILY LAUNCHED IN IRAN.

text.p: Iran Daily, the Islamic republic's fourth English-language newspaper, was launched on Wednesday, two days before the country's presidential election.
The eight-page tabloid said it would concentrate on domestic and regional economic affairs. The main story in its inaugural issue was on the countdown to Friday's poll.
The newspaper is produced by the official Islamic Republic News Agency (IRNA). It competes with Iran News, Kayhan International and Tehran Times.
